title: V6 CY E2E s2c: Mode B timeout refund (single-shard retest)
owner_gate: Cluster restarted with short cross_shard_lock_timeout_blocks genesis; head growing ≥2 min
brief: Retest s2 (variant C): on-chain Mode B EXPORT on single-shard CY without target peer; wait until unlock_height; assert refund_exp_locks restores spendable (fees only). Roaming intent TTL expire is NOT the refund oracle.
acceptance_criteria: Owner restarted CY with genesis cross_shard_lock_timeout_blocks in 5..20 (not default 604800); clean state or documented fresh account
On-chain EXPORT via pwm-cli tx-export (or documented equivalent that applies TxBody::Export on seal, not roaming-only intent)
After EXPORT: spendable decreases by amount+fee; CrossShardLock exists in Locked state
Target shard peer NOT required; follower 127.0.0.3 may stay down
After head >= unlock_height (natural seal or proposer lab-seal RPC): lock state Refunded
Spendable returns to baseline minus export fees only (locked amount refunded)
Report tmp/cy-e2e-v6-s2c-<timestamp>.md with PASS_EVIDENCE and recorded lock_height/unlock_height/head_at_refund
If genesis still has default 604800 timeout → status BLOCKED (harness config), not product FAIL
owner_actions: Point PWM_DEMO_GENESIS_PATH to genesis with cross_shard_lock_timeout_blocks=10 (testing may write tmp/genesis-custom-s2c.json from tmp/genesis-custom.json)
Clean state tmp/state-cy-* OR accept new funded account for export
Start cy-cluster-attester.ps1 then cy-cluster-proposer.ps1 (single-shard; no follower required)
Confirm GET /v1/status head_height grows; notify testing companion
testing_procedure: Use skill colloquium-cqds-mcp; no wide workspace grep if CQDS available
Read /v1/status genesis or cfg for cross_shard_lock_timeout_blocks; abort BLOCKED if still 604800
Baseline: GET account spendable_on_this_shard for demo-genesis wallet sender
pwm-cli tx-export to foreign-domain address (CZ); record export_id and inclusion height
Optional negative control: roaming intent may expire — document but do not use as refund signal
Poll head until >= unlock_height (inclusion + timeout); cluster proposer allows /v1/lab-seal on loopback to advance if natural seal slow
Evidence lock Refunded: snapshot/cross-shard facts/account-info as available; cite heights in report

delegations.prompt_summary: Mis-routed s2c soak; blocked then PASS after genesis restart

notes: Coding companion PASS (204139). Formal testing retest: tasks/20260608-v6-cy-e2e-s2c-post-commit-retest.json.
